subject.title: fix: bound historical public proof expiry

question: Should historical outage fallback retain a five-second post-expiry grace period, accepting a 502 for older cached proofs in exchange for bounded public-visibility authorization?
rationale: The exact grace duration is an authorization-versus-availability policy choice; source review can confirm consistency but cannot determine the repository's acceptable outage tolerance.

options.title: Accept five-second grace
options.body: Merge the bounded grace after runtime proof confirms both outcomes, preserving short outage tolerance while preventing indefinite expired-proof reuse.

options.title: Use a different policy boundary
options.body: Ask for a revised duration or no post-expiry grace if the repository's public-route availability requirements require a different authorization policy.

recommendation.title: Accept five-second grace
recommendation.body: Merge the bounded grace after runtime proof confirms both outcomes, preserving short outage tolerance while preventing indefinite expired-proof reuse.
